reviewer: Codex team AI reviewer, not a human teacher
review_scope: 57 numeric topics times five authored wordings; default generated rows, exact-pattern runtime binding, declared units, carry/borrow and inverse checks. Does not cover a separately authored categorical curriculum module.

manual_semantic_review.source_bindings: Numbers extracted only from exact published fullmatch patterns; repeated placeholders must agree; arbitrary paraphrases/instructions are rejected.
manual_semantic_review.sum_difference: Generated sum/difference derives from two naturals; parity and total>=difference ensure integral nonnegative roots.
manual_semantic_review.ratio: Generated totals divisible by sum of parts; first-group numerator consistent through all wordings.
manual_semantic_review.fractions: Currentgrade4add/sub examples respect reduced-denominator same/multiple relation; arithmetic uses exactfractions.
manual_semantic_review.probability: Theoretical object-selection probability is labelled enrichment; empirical_frequency is separate and explicitly describes observed trials.
manual_semantic_review.vertical: Written digits reconstruct answer; donor reductions propagate through zero columns; final inverse returns minuend/firstaddend. Observed result mismatch never claims unseen carrymark diagnosis.

limitations: Arithmetic/template agreement does not certify unseen Vietnamese semantics, all current/legacy curricula or human pedagogical quality.
Legacy/enrichment families retain unverified legacy grade labels; current examples retain engineered/pending-source-mapping metadata.
Most numeric recipes are compact observable explanations, not exhaustive longdivision/multiplication/decimal algorithms or all alternate methods.
Grade3/4 arbitrarily hard vertical carry/borrow examples are explicitly capstone extensions; current classroom carry limits are not universal runtime guarantees.
Runtime may reject valid alternate wordings/valid domains; accepted results only cover explicitly published patterns and configured restrictions.
This audit supplies reference JSON to runtime to test renderer/gates; it is not a neuralmodelaccuracybenchmark.
No images, OCR, actual student written carry marks, physical measurements or private teacher gold were audited.
A few contexts such as low đồng prices or garden lengths in cm are mathematically valid but should receive later teacher realism review.
